It has also been narrated that when Hadhrat Umar (RA) once arrived in Shaam, food that he had never before set eyes upon was prepared for him. He asked, "While we eat this, what will the poor Muslims have who die without filling themselves with even barley bread?" Hadhrat Umar bin Waleed replied, "They shall have Jannah." Tears then started to flow from the eyes of Hadhrat Umar (RA) as he said, "If this (food) is our share while they have made off with Jannah, then they have certainly excelled us with a tremendous virtue."[^1]
The Incident with his Son Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) and Daughter Hadhrat Hafsah (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) (the son of Hadhrat Umar (RA)) narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once came to his house while he was eating. Hadhrat Umar (RA) made space for his father at the head of the table. (When he sat down) Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "Bismillaah" and then put his hand to the food. He ate a morsel and then another. Thereafter, he commented, "I can taste the presence of something that is not the natural fat of meat (this meat has not been cooked in its own fat)." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) submitted, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! I went to the marketplace (with two Dirhams) to look for some fatty meat to buy but found that it was too expensive (more than two Dirhams). I then bought the meat of a thin animal for a Dirham and cooked it with some butter that I bought for another Dirham. I wanted each member of my family to have at least one bone to eat.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "Whenever these two things (meat and butter) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he only ate one of them and gave the other away as Sadaqah (I shall therefore not eat)." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "Please eat, O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Whenever the two again come in my possession at the same time, I shall also do the same." "I cannot," replied Hadhrat Umar (RA).[^2]

Abu Haazim reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once went to see his daughter Hadhrat Hafsah (RA) who served him some cold gravy and bread. She then poured some olive oil into it. "Two gravies in one!" remarked Hadhrat Umar (RA), "I shall not eat this until the day I meet Allaah."[^3]
The Narrations of Hadhrat Anas (RA) and Hadhrat Saa'ib bin Yazeed (RA) Concerning the Food of Hadhrat Umar (RA)
Hadhrat Anas (RA) says, "When he was Khalifah, I saw that when a Saa of dates was given to Hadhrat Umar (RA), he would even eat the dates that were of an inferior quality."
